parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg of the pliers, made of steel, forming one of the two handles used to apply force. It is approximately 10 cm long and 1.5 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: The leg acts as a lever arm that allows the user to grip and apply pressure to objects when the handles are squeezed together.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the base body to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, forming the main structure that includes one handle and one jaw. It is approximately 10 cm long and 1.5 cm wide.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and serves as the fixed lever arm that works with the leg to grip and manipulate objects.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary while the leg rotates around the pivot point to perform the gripping action.
